compositions.prompt: Medium shot of Ruslan standing at the scenic Belaya river embankment in Ufa during warm golden hour. Medium portrait of Ruslan in front of a contemporary premium residential complex in Ufa with stylish brick and glass facade and landscaped autumn trees. Ruslan on an elevated rooftop terrace overlooking the expansive Ufa city skyline and autumn park greenery. Dressed in a tailored navy wool overcoat, open collar dress shirt. Modern city panorama under clear evening sky, tranquil and prestigious editorial look.

Ruslan standing near the renovated historic and modern plaza of Gostiny Dvor in central Ufa, clear autumn afternoon. Elegant dark wool coat, white collared shirt underneath. Premium editorial style, holding a slim leather tablet portfolio. Dignified calm expensive vibe.

Ruslan walking along a clean, modern Ufa park boulevard flanked by contemporary residential buildings, soft afternoon light. Wearing a structured dark overcoat and dark turtleneck. Calm, trustworthy and polished editorial portrait.
